tasks.short: Prepare lists of legal instruments applying.

steps.what: Query legal instruments applying to that specific piece.
Read instruments applying to the buildings.
Accept the lists of legal instruments.

tasks.design: The examiner reads the instruments applying to the buildings and accepts the lists. {GOV_PORTAL} only returns instruments the register indexes for that specific piece. {DOCS} prepares the lists they accepted. The query does not examine an instrument. A row that does not apply is dropped by the examiner, not by the query.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same index was copied into a list before the examiner had read it.
tasks.enabler_now: An instrument index can be queried by the parcel the file already names.
tasks.still_hard: Which instruments apply to this piece and its buildings stays with the examiner.
tasks.human_edge: The examiner accepts the list. A query does not examine.
tasks.altitude: Reading the instruments and accepting the lists stay in full. Only the query and preparing the accepted lists are shorter.

reach.task: Use the list the examiner accepted
reach.learn: The searcher does not decide which instrument applies

evidence.claim: A parcel query can list instruments the register already indexes. It does not examine them.
Names and title documents are personal data. They leave only in a version the examiner has accepted.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a specific piece is named and ends when the accepted list is prepared. The examiner reads and accepts. The query does not examine.
The fields are parcel id and instrument id. The register produces the index row. The examiner drops a row that does not apply. If the portal rejects the query, they search by hand.
The prior classes this task as automate. The steps disagree in part: the reading and the acceptance stay. The query and the prepare are the parts that move.
unknowns: Whether buildings on the piece have their own instrument index.
What the office does when the portal rejects the parcel query.
research_questions: Do buildings on the piece have their own instrument index?
What does the office do when the portal rejects the parcel query?

tasks.short: Summarize recorded documents and file them.

steps.what: Pull recorded documents that affect the property.
Summarize trust deeds and contracts that affect the titles.
Check mortgages the summary did not cover.

tasks.design: The examiner summarizes the trust deeds and contracts and checks the mortgages the summary did not cover. {DOCS} only pulls recorded documents by the id already on the file, then files the version they accepted. The copy uses stated fields. A clause those fields do not hold is not invented. The examiner writes every line of the summary.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stated parties, dates, and amounts were retyped from documents already on the file.
tasks.enabler_now: Stated fields on a recorded document can be copied into the note the examiner is writing.
tasks.still_hard: What the document means for the title stays with the examiner who writes the summary.
tasks.human_edge: The examiner writes the summary. A copy does not invent a clause.
tasks.altitude: The summary and the mortgage check stay in full. Only the pull of recorded documents and the filing of the accepted version are shorter.

reach.task: Read the summary the examiner accepted
reach.learn: The searcher does not write the summary

evidence.claim: Stated fields on a recorded document can be copied. A clause the fields do not hold is not invented.
A summary used in an examination must not add a citation the examiner did not take from the book in front of them. A line with no page is not filed.
Confidential title files are not pasted into a free tool. A copy uses only fields the examiner already marked.
Names and title documents are personal data. They leave only in a version the examiner has accepted.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a recorded document is on the file and ends when the accepted summary is filed. The examiner writes the summary. The copy does not invent a clause.
The fields are document id and the stated fields: parties, date, and amount. The recorded document produces those fields. The examiner writes any summary. A field that is blank is left blank.
The prior classes this task as automate. The steps disagree in part: the summary stays. The pull and the filing are the parts that move.
unknowns: Whether trust deeds on this file are already image-only, with no stated fields.
Which clauses the office requires the examiner to write even when the fields are complete.

tasks.short: Verify documents and send rejection notices.

steps.what: Decide which documents are not acceptable.

tasks.design: The examiner verifies accuracy and completeness, decides which documents are not acceptable, and finishes preparing the rejection notices. {EMAIL} sends only the notice they accepted, and only when they have marked the document not acceptable. If it is acceptable, the send stays unused. The notice only restates the reason they wrote. Nothing rejects a document on its own.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same reason was retyped into the notice after the examiner had already written it.
tasks.enabler_now: A notice can restate a reason the examiner has already written on the file.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a document is acceptable for registration stays with the examiner.
tasks.human_edge: The examiner decides. A notice does not reject the document.
tasks.altitude: The verification, the decision, and preparing the notices stay in full. Only opening the presented document and sending the accepted notice are shorter.

reach.task: Receive a rejection the examiner accepted
reach.learn: The presenter does not decide acceptability

evidence.claim: Rejecting a document for registration is the examiner's decision. The notice only restates the reason they wrote.
Names and title documents are personal data. They leave only in a version the examiner has accepted.
National rules differ on who may register a document and on which legislation applies. The examiner determines whether it can be registered. This file does not register it.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a document is presented for registration and ends when an accepted rejection is sent, or when the examiner marks the document acceptable and no notice goes out. The examiner verifies and decides.
The fields are document id, the result acceptable or not, and the reason. The presenter produces the document. The examiner produces the reason. No reason means no rejection is sent.
The prior classes this task as amplify. The steps agree the verification and the decision stay. The open and the send are the parts that move.
unknowns: Whether an acceptable document is filed by another role after this check.

tasks.short: Read search requests and file the accepted ones.

steps.what: Ascertain types of title evidence required.
Obtain descriptions of the properties and names.

tasks.design: The examiner ascertains the types of title evidence required and obtains the descriptions and names. {DOCS} only opens a request that is already written, then files the request they accepted. An unclear request is not filed as complete. Nothing decides which evidence the search needs.
tasks.previous_blocker: A request that was already written was retyped before the examiner could read it.
tasks.enabler_now: A request that already names the evidence, the description, and the parties can be opened as it stands.
tasks.still_hard: Which title evidence this search requires stays with the examiner.
tasks.human_edge: The examiner ascertains the evidence. An opened request does not.
tasks.altitude: Ascertaining the evidence and obtaining the descriptions stay in full. Only opening a written request and filing the accepted request are shorter.

reach.task: Start from the request the examiner accepted
reach.learn: The searcher does not choose the evidence

evidence.claim: Stated fields on a recorded document can be copied. A clause the fields do not hold is not invented.
Names and title documents are personal data. They leave only in a version the examiner has accepted.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a search request has arrived and ends when the accepted request is filed. The examiner ascertains the evidence and obtains the description. An unclear request is not filed as complete.

The fields are request id, evidence type, description, and party names. The order produces them when they are already written. The examiner types a missing description. An unclear request is not filed as complete.
The prior classes this task as amplify. The steps agree the ascertaining stays. The open and the filing are the parts that move.
